tools.name: declareAgent
tools.description: Identify yourself as an AI agent visiting this site. Declared agents are recognized as assistants acting for a user. Call this once when you arrive.

acting_for_user.description: True if acting on behalf of a human user.

purpose.description: Optional. Short, generic reason for the visit. Omit personal details.

tools.name: get_site_guide
tools.description: Get the fastest way to complete a task on this site. Call this first when starting a task here. Optionally identify your agent so guidance can be tailored.

task.description: What you are trying to accomplish.

tools.name: report_site_issue
tools.description: Report a bug, blocker, or confusing part of this site so the site team can fix it. Call this when something blocks or slows your task, or when you finish or abandon a task.

issue.description: What went wrong or was confusing. Omit personal details.

selector.description: Optional. CSS selector of the problem element.
